_meta.definition: The process of managing airline reservations, including booking, seat allocation, passenger information, and pricing.

booking._description: Tracks reservations for specific flights, including seat assignments, passenger information, and pricing details.

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in booking

columns.name: flight_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the flight_ entity

columns.name: seat
columns.description: Stores aircraft seat identifiers in a format of alphabetical row (e.g., F, E) and numerical column (e.g., 25, 24).

columns.name: passenger_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the passenger_ entity

columns.name: price
columns.description: Stores booking prices in floating point format.
